headline: Five rooms, a quiet street, and the whole island within an hour
intro: A small guest house above Portree harbour, run by the family who live in it.
heroCaption: The Old Man of Storr, twenty minutes north of the door
roomsIntro: Five rooms, each with its own shower room, each sleeping two. A complimentary breakfast is included. Parking is available on request.
houseText:
Skye asks a lot of a day. Long drives, weather that changes its mind, more walking than you planned. The house is what you come back to: somewhere to dry your boots and sleep without traffic outside the window.

A complimentary breakfast is laid out in the kitchen from seven and you help yourself, so you can eat at seven or at nine without waiting on anyone. There is no cooked breakfast and no set sitting. You are welcome to cook for yourself as well.
islandText: Portree is the middle of Skye, which is the practical argument for staying here rather than somewhere prettier and further out. Everything is a morning away.
bookText: Booking direct costs you no more than the booking sites and leaves us able to look after you properly. Call if you would rather speak to someone.
